{{Top|leg}}
The '''Zygerrian Royal House''' was the name given to the ruling family of the [[Slavery/Legends|slaver]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Zygerria/Legends|Zygerria]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Miraj Scintel/Legends|Miraj Scintel]] was the ruling [[Queen/Legends|Queen]]. After her death, [[Atai Molec/Legends|Atai Molec]] became the new [[King/Legends|King]], with his family becoming the new Royal House.
